injuries.name: Norman Powell
injuries.note: Powell (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the 76ers, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

injuries.name: Zach Collins
injuries.note: Collins (illness) is out for Sunday's game against Philadelphia.

injuries.name: Adem Bona
injuries.note: Bona (back) is out for Sunday's game in Chicago.

injuries.name: Joel Embiid
injuries.note: Embiid (foot) is probable for Sunday's game against the Bulls.

injuries.name: Dominick Barlow
injuries.note: Head coach Nick Nurse said Wednesday that Barlow (back) likely needs another 10-12 days before he's cleared to return to the court, Derek Bodner of AllPHLY.com reports.

injuries.name: Ariel Hukporti
injuries.note: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Jalen Duren
injuries.note: Duren (hamstring) has begun on-court activity and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Isaiah Joe
injuries.note: Joe (hip) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Lakers.

injuries.name: Luka Doncic
injuries.note: Doncic has been ruled out for Sunday's game at Detroit due to lower-back tightness, Trevor Lane of LakersNation.com reports.

injuries.name: Anthony Edwards
injuries.note: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

injuries.name: Donte DiVincenzo
injuries.note: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Lauri Markkanen
injuries.note: Markkanen is questionable for Sunday's game against the Timberwolves due to a right wrist sprain.

injuries.name: Keyonte George
injuries.note: George (illness) has been downgraded to questionable for Sunday's game against Minnesota.

injuries.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
injuries.note: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Jusuf Nurkic
injuries.note: Nurkic (toe) has begun participating in on-court activities as he continues recovering from a right foot injury sustained during an Oct. 4 preseason game against Denver. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks, the Jazz announced Friday.

injuries.name: Sergio de Larrea
injuries.note: De Larrea (knee) is out for Friday's game against Utah.

injuries.name: Tarik Biberovic
injuries.note: Biberovic (heel) is listed as out for Monday's game against Sacramento.

injuries.name: Dereck Lively II
injuries.note: Lively (foot) is listed as out for Monday's game against the Kings.

injuries.name: Egor Demin
injuries.note: The Nets exercised Demin's third-year team option for the 2027-28 season, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports Thursday.

injuries.name: Mikel Brown Jr.
injuries.note: Brown, who finished with 18 points (5-13 FG, 3-8 3Pt, 5-7 FT), one rebound, three assists and one steal over 25 minutes in Saturday's 124-121 loss to Atlanta, won't play in Sunday's game against Dallas, Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Grant Nelson
injuries.note: Nelson signed a two-way contract with the Nets on Friday, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

injuries.name: Gary Trent Jr.
injuries.note: Trent (illness) has been downgraded to questionable for Sunday's game against Boston.

injuries.name: Mitchell Robinson
injuries.note: Robinson (illness) is questionable for Sunday's game versus Milwaukee, Bobby Krivitsky of Forbes.com reports.

injuries.name: Isaiah Jackson
injuries.note: Jackson (groin) won't suit up for Sunday's game against the Pelicans, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Brandon Ingram
injuries.note: Ingram (Achilles) won't play in Sunday's game against New Orleans, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
injuries.note: The Clippers recalled Niederhauser (foot) from the G League's San Diego Clippers on Sunday.

injuries.name: Bradley Beal
injuries.note: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

injuries.name: Jordan Miller
injuries.note: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Yves Missi
injuries.note: Missi (knee) is out for Friday's game against Minnesota.

injuries.name: Keegan Murray
injuries.note: Murray (ankle) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Heat.

injuries.name: Maxime Raynaud
injuries.note: Raynaud (knee) is progressing in his rehabilitation and will be re-evaluated in approximately two weeks, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

injuries.name: Ben Simmons
injuries.note: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

notes: Payout table (partly an assumption): Power 2/3/4/5/6 picks pay 3x/6x/10x/20x/37.5x and Flex 3/4/5/6 picks pay 3x/6x/10x/25x when all hit, per PrizePicks' help centre as summarised by web search on 2026-11-07 (the site itself is blocked from the build host). Flex partial tiers (3-pick 1x with one miss, 4-pick 1.5x, 5-pick 2x/0.4x, 6-pick 2x/0.4x) are from secondary sources. PrizePicks notes some lineups (e.g. several players from one game) pay differently: check the multiplier the app shows.
Minimum entry assumed $5 (official help centre, via web search 2026-11-07); Happy Hour promos can be lower.
Standard (non-Demon/Goblin) projections only; a voided leg (DNP, tie on a whole-number line) is counted as a loss here, which understates slip value slightly.
PrizePicks board unavailable: blocked (HTTP 403): PrizePicks refuses this network; DraftKings lines used as the proxy.
The reference ledger records at most 2 $5 entries per night (the 10% night cap on $100); slips are ranked.
Pick'em edges are PROVISIONAL: no historical PrizePicks line archive exists, so the leg probabilities are market-anchored (DraftKings) and shrunk at s = 0.5 until the live ledger grades enough slips.

PrizePicks lines were not available to the server, so these legs use DraftKings' main line as a stand-in. A slip is only worth playing where PrizePicks posts a line at or better than each leg's take-it threshold (More if the line is at most X, Less if at least Y). Type the app's lines into the table to re-price.
Fliff minimum wager assumed $0.25 (ASSUMPTION, unverified; configurable in jghedge.config).
Game totals and cross-game parlays only; spreads and moneylines are informational (lost in two of three replayed seasons).
Lines are DraftKings via ESPN unless an Odds API key supplies Fliff's own number; bet the number shown or better.

growth.basis: bootstrap of nightly returns from data/replay_open.json seasons 2024-2027 (1028 nights, both seeds); returns are the balanced profile at k=0.25 scaled by k/0.25 for other k; each night's stake is split across its bets, rounded to whole units, capped at 5% per bet and 10% per night, and the night is skipped when a bet rounds below one unit; 2000 paths of 160 nights, seed 1
